description: The “household” questionnaire asked for information on all aspects of the household.  It has been used annually since the first survey wave in 1984. Current topics of the household questionnaire in the 2024 survey wave were:  Housing situation, ownership and rent, income and expenditure, assets and investments, household management, and children and care.
description_de: Der Haushaltsfragebogen erfasste Informationen zu allen Aspekten des Haushalts. Er wird seit der ersten Erhebungswelle im Jahr 1984 jährlich eingesetzt.
